title: Gateway slot claims expose a forgeable signature_valid authorization bit
description: Security review P1. New rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs represents authentication as public bool SlotClaim.signature_valid and exposes with_valid_signature(), which simply sets it true without a signature, key, TOFU pin, transcript, or verification. resolve_conflict treats that bit as authoritative, so any caller/decoder can forge a lower-IID valid claim and win overlapping slots. Replace the boolean with an opaque verified-claim capability issued only after Schnorr/OSCORE verification and IID binding; keep raw claims separate; test that neither struct construction nor builder calls can bypass verification.
